title: Allowing laneway houses in every neighbourhood
prompt:
Some cities are changing their rules so that homeowners in all residential neighbourhoods can build a small second home, such as a laneway house, on their property.

Do you think this is a good idea? Explain your reasons.
structure: Clear position + main reason in one sentence
Reason 1: more homes without changing the neighbourhood much
modelAnswer:
Yes, I think it's a good idea to allow laneway houses in all residential neighbourhoods, mainly because of the housing shortage we're facing.

First and foremost, it creates more homes without changing the character of a neighbourhood too much. Instead of building huge towers, you're just adding a small house behind an existing one. There are a few laneway homes on my street already, and honestly, most people don't even notice them.

Secondly, it helps families. A lot of immigrant families, including many of my Vietnamese friends, want their parents to live close by but still have some privacy. A laneway house is perfect for that. It can also be a home for adult children who can't afford rent on their own.

Another benefit is extra income for homeowners. Renting out a laneway house can help people pay their mortgage, which is a big deal with today's interest rates.

Now, some people worry about parking and crowded streets, and I think that's a fair concern. But cities can deal with that through design rules, like limiting the size of the house or requiring a parking space.

So, all things considered, I believe allowing laneway houses is a practical way to add housing, and the benefits clearly outweigh the drawbacks.

usefulExpressions.usageVi: Nêu lý do tổng quát ngay trong câu mở đầu.
Mở đầu lý do quan trọng nhất, mạnh hơn 'First'.

usefulExpressions.expression: which is a big deal with…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: 'a big deal' = điều quan trọng; cách nói tự nhiên trong văn nói.

usefulExpressions.expression: I think that's a fair concern. But…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Công nhận lo ngại hợp lý của người khác trước khi phản bác.
Cân nhắc mọi mặt — mở đầu kết luận ở mức điểm cao.

usefulExpressions.expression: the benefits clearly outweigh the drawbacks
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Câu kết kinh điển cho bài nêu quan điểm; 'outweigh' = lớn hơn, quan trọng hơn.

commonMistakes: Không biết từ 'laneway house' nên nói vòng vo hoặc dừng lại. Hãy dùng ngay từ trong đề; nếu cần, giải thích đơn giản: 'a small house in the backyard'.
Nói 'house price is very expensive' — 'price' không 'expensive'. Đúng: 'house prices are very high' hoặc 'houses are very expensive'.
Thiếu số nhiều/mạo từ: 'many immigrant family want parent live near' → 'many immigrant families want their parents to live nearby'.

review.notes: Independent review: Checked prompt realism (BC now allows small-scale secondary homes broadly), clear position, concern addressed, length (~209). No changes needed.
